sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United will host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00, looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Despite that setback, Sandbach remain top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, and they face an Alsager side struggling at the foot of the division with just 4 points from 10 matches. The visitors have won only once this season and arrive in poor form, making this a favorable opportunity for Sandbach to return to winning ways.
divisionWide: The title race will be tested as second-placed Stafford Town (20 points) travel to Dawley Town on Saturday, while third-placed AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall at home—both fixtures could shake up the top end of the table. Wolverhampton Casuals, sitting fourth on 19 points, face Wednesfield Community at home, then travel to face Brereton Social in midweek on Wednesday evening, a demanding double that could define their week. Bilston Town, in sixth place, visit Foley Meir, while higher-up Barnton host Shawbury United—currently on an alarming run of six straight losses. New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town in a clash of mid-table sides, while Telford Town visit Cheadle Heath Nomads and Crewe face Allscott Heath at home in fixtures between struggling teams. Widnes Town, bottom with 2 points, host Brereton Social on Saturday afternoon in a critical battle against relegation-form opponents.
